comparison.objective: Load a caulking gun and apply a continuous silicone bead along a bath joint.
comparison.physical_skill: Operate a release and plunger, seat a cartridge, meter the trigger, and guide a nozzle along a seam.
comparison.success_condition: Credit follows cartridge loading and joint coverage; full credit requires at least 95% sealed with no gap over 2 mm and the gun released.
comparison.reason: Its coupled actions load and dispense material, whereas the candidate preserves a screw-set angular stop while tightening a jam nut and verifies retention by cycling.
